text.p: Following are some of the main stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More than 75 pct of 25 largest bourse-listed companies posted earnings per share growth of more than ten pct. (p1)
- Differences between two payment circuits in Netherlands ironed out after 20 years of talks. (p1)
- Nedlloyd's logistics unit Flowmasters aims to double sales by 1998. (p1)
- Aging population in Netherlands will cost billions of guilders. (p1)
- Bank insurer Fortis Nederland considering closing gap between two banking subsidiaries. (p3)
- Dutch beer export growth weaker in 1996. (p2)
- Union and employers reach agreement on information campaign for part-time work. (p3)
- Radio-active waste should be reprocessed instead of stored, according to Dutch energy research centre ECN. (p5)
- Labour party PvdA wants hearing on expulsion of Iranians. (p1)
